collect_parties.instructions: Decide whether the applicant is also the insured person and the payer. If not, list the other people with their role (INSURED or PAYER), full_name and date_of_birth (ISO 8601). Use null for a date of birth the customer has not given; never invent one. The applicant is always the policyholder (계약자) and cannot be changed here; if the customer asks for someone else to be the policyholder, set policyholder_change_requested and still record who is insured and who pays.
collect_parties.correction: The parties recorded so far: {parties}. The customer is correcting the application; return the complete corrected parties. If the correction is not about who is insured or who pays, return the recorded parties unchanged.

instructions: Extract application answers from the customer's latest message into AnswersExtraction. Use exactly these field names: {fields}. Dates ISO 8601, money in minor units.
Write a short plain-language summary of this insurance application for the customer to confirm before submission. Use only these facts:

opened.en: Great choice. Let's complete your {product} application.

ask_parties.ko: 피보험자(보장받는 분)와 보험료를 내는 분이 모두 본인인가요? 다른 분이 있다면 그분의 역할(피보험자/납입자), 이름, 생년월일을 알려 주세요.
ask_parties.en: Are you both the insured person and the payer? If someone else is, tell me their role (insured or payer), full name and date of birth.

ask_party_details.ko: 다른 분의 이름과 생년월일을 알려 주세요.
ask_party_details.en: Please tell me the other person's full name and date of birth.

parties_self.en: Got it — you're the insured and the payer.

answers_handoff.ko: 청약에 필요한 정보를 다 받지 못해 상담원을 연결해 드릴게요.
answers_handoff.en: I still can't complete the application, so I'm bringing in an agent to help.

ask_answers.en: To complete the application, please provide {fields}.

ask_correction.en: What would you like to change?

submitted.ko: 청약을 제출했습니다. 접수번호는 {ref}입니다. 심사 결과는 따로 안내해 드릴게요.
submitted.en: Your application is submitted. Your reference number is {ref}. We'll be in touch with the underwriting decision.

summary_handoff.ko: 요약을 바로잡지 못해 상담원을 연결해 드릴게요. 입력하신 내용은 저장돼 있습니다.
summary_handoff.en: I haven't been able to get the summary right, so I'm bringing in an agent to help.

no_longer_eligible.ko:
알려 주신 내용으로는 {product}에 가입할 수 없습니다. 상담원이 이어서 도와드릴게요.
{reasons}
no_longer_eligible.en:
With what you've told me, {product} isn't available to you. An agent will follow up with you.
{reasons}

policyholder_is_applicant.ko: 계약자는 본인 확인을 마친 신청자 본인({name}님)만 될 수 있어요. 다른 분이 계약자가 되려면 그분이 직접 가입을 진행해야 합니다. 피보험자와 보험료 납입자는 바꿀 수 있어요.
policyholder_is_applicant.en: The policyholder can only be you ({name}), the verified applicant. For someone else to hold the policy, they need to apply themselves. The insured person and the payer can be someone else.
